status: Code-only slice applying the three owner rulings on the A28 ClamAV findings. Not lab-observed: no clamd was run, no container was built and no stack was started (another executor holds the machine's lab and Docker). Every claim below is read out of the code and pinned by a test that was verified RED before the change; the behaviour against a REAL clamd is INT-04's already-passing A28 lane, which this slice does not re-run.
scope: Rulings on A28 findings 1 (a malware rejection is invisible to the creator), 2 (fail-open has no audit trail) and the CLAMAV_ADDR-unset default (silently unscanned), plus the ingestion-scope gap A28 recorded as unprobed: thumbnails, avatars, channel banners and account-import archives.

pull_requests.ordering: No OpenAPI schema changed (the two new error codes are prose in the ErrorResponse envelope, not an enum), so there is no contract-ci ordering and no client regeneration. The user PR does not have to land after core. The META PR does: its templates set MALWARE_SCAN_MODE=disabled, which vidra-core v0.6.2 rejects as an unknown mode at boot.

unverified: NOT lab-observed: no clamd was started, no EICAR body was scanned, no container was built and no stack was run in this slice. The real-daemon behaviour is INT-04's A28 lane, unchanged by this slice.
NOT run: the core integration and ipfs-* tagged lanes locally (CI ran them green on core#201), any frontend e2e or e2e-backed lane, and vidra-search (untouched).

The in-memory scan of the small object classes is proven against a fake FileScanner, not clamd. ClamAV.ScanBytes shares the whole INSTREAM body with the already-exercised Scan; only the reader source differs.
The one-per-boot system.malware_scan.disabled audit row is pinned by reading the boot path, not by observing a boot.
No measurement of what scanning every avatar and caption costs a busy instance in clamd round-trips.
hard_ordering_constraint: The meta env templates set MALWARE_SCAN_MODE=disabled. vidra-core v0.6.2 (the currently pinned release) validates MALWARE_SCAN_MODE against three values and REFUSES TO BOOT on 'disabled'. meta-ci's `validate` job runs the real loader through `vidra setup --check` against the pinned nested checkout and FAILS on this branch with: MALWARE_SCAN_MODE "disabled" must be one of fail-closed, fail-open, quarantine. That is the gate doing its job, not a defect. meta#150 stays DRAFT and is not mergeable until the nested vidra-core checkout is pinned at a release carrying core#201, at which point validate goes green with no edit to the branch. The prod compose render is clean regardless, because Compose does not validate the value.
